hotel_details.name: Address Sky View
hotel_details.description:
Live sky high at these surreal towers joined by the marvellous Sky Bridge. Indulge in classic Dubai luxury, with panoramic views of the city. 

Welcome to Address Sky View, a panoramic city viewpoint gracing Dubai’s skyline with two resplendent towers conjoined at the summit by an architecturally marvellous Sky Bridge, in the heart of Downtown Dubai. Here, guests and visitors are warmly welcomed to a confluence of attractive propositions. The rooms, suites and residences at Address Sky View reflect careful attention to every nuance of comfort and elegance, while matchless perspectives of the city beckon from the infinity pool above. Innovation and culinary finesse are essential ingredients that elevate each of the novel dining experiences, while wellness is delivered holistically via spa and fitness experiences characterised by new-age thinking. 

The Ballroom hosts some of the most spectacular social celebrations and formal felicitations, while corporate initiatives take on progressive new dimensions across superbly designed meeting rooms and amphitheatres. In this skyline-defining duo of towers, embrace the unique privilege of being ‘Where life happens’.

CLUB BENEFITS 
(CLUB BURJ VIEW ROOM (KING), CLUB TWIN BURJ VIEW ROOM, JUNIOR SUITE, EXECUTIVE SUITE SKY VIEW)
 24 hrs check in / out 
* Free shoe polishing
* pressing of one shirt and one suit per person on arrival only
* Club access lounge as follows: 
 - Breakfast
 - Lunch (light refreshments)
 - Afternoon tea time (cakes, fruits and sandwiches)
 - Dinner
 - Happy hour (selected beverages)
 - Late night offer (post dinner offering such as cakes, fruits and sandwiches)


NOTICE:
View Hotel lobby will be closed for seasonal maintenance between 30 March 2022 to 30 April 2022.
In order to extend the service to guests, front office operations will be serviced according to below program.



Hotel reception is relocated to Address Sky View Tower 2 Residence Reception and all front offices services will be delivered through the same reception during the maintenance period
Hotel rooms and restaurant guest drop off will be serviced from Address Sky View Tower 2 Residence Reception
Valet pick up, Taxi / Limo pick up, Tour pick up will be serviced from Address Sky View Events Entrance
Patisserie at the lobby area will be closed from 30 March 2022 to 30 April 2022
Lobby Lounge will be operational for coffee and tea services to hotel guests

Please note that Dubai's Ultimate Pool is accessible to hotel guests only (18 years and above).
Timing: 9am to 7pm

value.title: Sky High Dining
value.description: Indulge in a culinary journey at the hotel's rooftop restaurant, offering breathtaking views of Dubai's skyline while savoring delectable dishes from around the world.

value.title: Infinity Pool Bliss
value.description: Take a dip in the hotel's stunning infinity pool, perched on the 54th floor. Enjoy the panoramic views of the city while relaxing in the crystal-clear waters.

value.title: Spa Retreat
value.description: Pamper yourself at the hotel's luxurious spa, where skilled therapists offer a range of rejuvenating treatments and massages to melt away your stress and leave you feeling refreshed.

value.title: Dubai Mall Shopping
value.description: Explore the world's largest shopping mall, located just a short distance from the hotel. Discover a plethora of high-end fashion brands, entertainment options, and even an indoor aquarium.

value.title: Burj Khalifa Visit
value.description: Don't miss the chance to visit the iconic Burj Khalifa, the tallest building in the world. Take an elevator ride to the observation deck on the 148th floor for breathtaking views of the city.

value.title: Desert Safari Adventure
value.description: Embark on an exhilarating desert safari adventure, where you can ride a camel, go dune bashing, try sandboarding, and experience traditional Bedouin culture with a delicious dinner under the stars.

value.title: Dubai Marina Walk
value.description: Stroll along the vibrant Dubai Marina Walk, lined with trendy cafes, restaurants, and boutique shops. Enjoy the stunning waterfront views and soak up the lively atmosphere of this cosmopolitan area.

value.title: Dubai Fountain Show
value.description: Witness the mesmerizing Dubai Fountain Show, located near the hotel. Marvel at the synchronized water, light, and music spectacle as the fountains dance in perfect harmony against the backdrop of the Burj Khalifa.

  • Government-issued photo identification and a credit card, debit card, or cash deposit may be required at check-in for incidental charges
  • Special requests are subject to availability upon check-in and may incur additional charges; special requests cannot be guaranteed
  • Guests must contact this property in advance to reserve cribs/infant beds and rollaway/extra beds

  • Safety features at this property include a fire extinguisher, a security system, and a first aid kit

  • A tax is imposed by the city: AED 20.00 per accommodation, per night

Optional fees:
  • Fee for continental breakfast: approximately AED 148 per person
  • Rollaway bed fee: AED 350.0 per night

The above list may not be comprehensive. Fees and deposits may not include tax and are subject to change.

Know before you go:
  • One child 3 years old or younger stays free when occupying the parent or guardian's room, using existing bedding.
  • Only registered guests are allowed in the guestrooms.
  • No pets and no service animals are allowed at this property.
  • Contactless check-in and contactless check-out are available.

CheckIn instructions:
  • Extra-person charges may apply and vary depending on property policy
  • Government-issued photo identification and a credit card, debit card, or cash deposit may be required at check-in for incidental charges
  • Special requests are subject to availability upon check-in and may incur additional charges; special requests cannot be guaranteed
  • Guests must contact this property in advance to reserve cribs/infant beds and rollaway/extra beds

CheckIn special instructions: Front desk staff will greet guests on arrival. Mandatory fees:

You'll be asked to pay the following charges at the property. Fees may include applicable taxes:

  • A tax is imposed by the city: AED 20.00 per accommodation, per night

We have included all charges provided to us by the property.

Optional fees:
  • Fee for continental breakfast: approximately AED 148 per person
  • Rollaway bed fee: AED 350.0 per night

The above list may not be comprehensive. Fees and deposits may not include tax and are subject to change.

Know before you go:
  • One child 3 years old or younger stays free when occupying the parent or guardian's room, using existing bedding.
  • Only registered guests are allowed in the guestrooms.
  • No pets and no service animals are allowed at this property.
  • Contactless check-in and contactless check-out are available.
Additional fees for 2 people: Name: mandatory_tax, Cost: 5.45 USD Tax Recovery Charges and Service Fees for 2 people: 53.57 USD (This amount is included within the total price).

CheckIn instructions:
  • Extra-person charges may apply and vary depending on property policy
  • Government-issued photo identification and a credit card, debit card, or cash deposit may be required at check-in for incidental charges
  • Special requests are subject to availability upon check-in and may incur additional charges; special requests cannot be guaranteed
  • Guests must contact this property in advance to reserve cribs/infant beds and rollaway/extra beds
  • This property accepts credit cards, debit cards, and cash
  • Safety features at this property include a fire extinguisher, a security system, and a first aid kit
  • Please note that cultural norms and guest policies may differ by country and by property; the policies listed are provided by the property

  • Contactless check-in and contactless check-out are available.

additional_info.tariff_notes:
CheckIn instructions:
  • Extra-person charges may apply and vary depending on property policy
  • Government-issued photo identification and a credit card, debit card, or cash deposit may be required at check-in for incidental charges
  • Special requests are subject to availability upon check-in and may incur additional charges; special requests cannot be guaranteed
  • Guests must contact this property in advance to reserve cribs/infant beds and rollaway/extra beds
  • This property accepts credit cards, debit cards, and cash
  • Safety features at this property include a fire extinguisher, a security system, and a first aid kit
  • Please note that cultural norms and guest policies may differ by country and by property; the policies listed are provided by the property
  • This property’s 54th-floor infinity pool is restricted to guests 18 years of age and older.
CheckIn special instructions: Front desk staff will greet guests on arrival. Mandatory fees:

You'll be asked to pay the following charges at the property. Fees may include applicable taxes:

  • A tax is imposed by the city: AED 20.00 per accommodation, per night

We have included all charges provided to us by the property.

Optional fees:
  • Fee for continental breakfast: approximately AED 148 per person
  • Rollaway bed fee: AED 350.0 per night

The above list may not be comprehensive. Fees and deposits may not include tax and are subject to change.

Know before you go:
  • One child 3 years old or younger stays free when occupying the parent or guardian's room, using existing bedding.
  • Only registered guests are allowed in the guestrooms.
  • No pets and no service animals are allowed at this property.
  • Contactless check-in and contactless check-out are available.
Additional fees for 2 people: Name: mandatory_tax, Cost: 5.45 USD Tax Recovery Charges and Service Fees for 2 people: 58.17 USD (This amount is included within the total price).

An additional charges of AED 20 per night, which is the tourism Dirham fee will be collected from the guest on check out. Existing reservation cannot be cancelled and re-booked under lower promotion. Hotel reception is relocated to Address Sky View Tower 2 Residence Reception and all front offices services including rooms and restaurant guest drop off will be delivered through the same reception during the maintenance period. Valet pick up, Taxi / Limo pick up, Tour pick up will be serviced from Address Sky View Events Entrance. Patisserie at the lobby area will be closed. Lobby Lounge will be operational for coffee and tea services. Flight details & passport copies must require proofing the guest is not UAE resident or from Restrict markets in order to proceed with the booking Please Note: Swimming pools at Address Sky View will be closed for routine maintenance, and enhancements as follows: (Please note that we have made sure that the three pool closures do not overlap, guests will always have one of the Hotel pools available for their use). Infinity Pool Closure: 1st July 2024 to 30th September 2024. Please note guests are not allowed to cancel existing bookings and rebook. The hotel has the right to reject the booking. Note: Adults pool closed due to maintenance from start of 08/21/2024 from 31/08/2024. Extended to Sep, 30, 2024</body></html>
